info.name: Kadou24h — Manual Test (A to Z)
info.description:
Full journey for every role: admin setup → accounts → vendor & rider onboarding → local COD order → COD settlement & withdrawals → online payment / cancel / refund / dispute → intercity 3-leg relay → jobs & CV → chat / reviews / support → admin controls → security checks.

**Before you start** (Collection → Variables): set `baseUrl`, `adminEmail`, `adminPassword`, `webhookSecret`, `emailUser`.

**Run in order.** Every request saves the ids and tokens the next ones need (tokens: ADMIN_TOKEN, C_TOKEN customer, V_TOKEN vendor, R_TOKEN rider, B_TOKEN bus driver, X_TOKEN stranger).

**OTP:** register sends a code to the email. Paste it into the `otp` variable, then send the verify request.

**[ADMIN]** requests can also be done in the Admin Dashboard (the description says where).

**Webhook** requests stand in for the Orange Money / MTN gateway and mark the last `paymentId` as paid.
